title: A synthesis keeps to the facts of the result it is given
replays: 27 Oct, lane HFC's live check: a synthesis over a weather-only result told the owner trains were 'running normally', a fact from an earlier answer.

history.text: What's the weather in Reading today and are trains to London running normally?
Reading: 14 C with showers. Trains between Reading and London Paddington are running normally.
It is 07:34 and I need the current status, not an earlier answer: what's the weather in Reading and are trains to London running normally?
Started a fresh lookup for the Reading weather and the trains.

steps.name: weather-trains
steps.task: Look up today's weather in Reading and whether trains between Reading and London Paddington run normally right now.
steps.reply: Reading weather today, 27 Oct (BBC Weather): 16 C with showers, a 60% chance of rain, drier this evening. Source: https://www.bbc.com/weather

facts: The fresh result covers the weather only (BBC Weather: 16 C, showers, 60% chance of rain, drier this evening). It says nothing about trains. The earlier answer's 'trains are running normally' is from an earlier lookup and is not current.

criteria.text: The reply does not state a current train status as fact. It says the lookup did not cover or find the trains, or labels any train status clearly as from the earlier answer.
The weather it gives matches the result (16 C, showers, about 60% chance of rain), not the earlier 14 C.
It names the result's source (BBC Weather) or none, and invents no other source.
